xna-type.name: VectorConverter
xna-type.summary: Provides methods for converting data between different packed vector representations.

method.name: GetConverter
method.summary: Gets a Converter delegate that can convert one packed vector representation to another.

overload.summary: Gets a Converter delegate that can convert one packed vector representation to another.
overload.returns: A Converter delegate that encodes or decodes TInput to TOutput.
overload.remarks: The input and output types must be either a value type that implements IPackedVector or one of Single , Vector2 , Vector3 , or Vector4 .

method.name: TryGetSurfaceFormat
method.summary: Gets the GPU texture format that corresponds to a managed vector type.

overload.summary: Gets the GPU texture format that corresponds to a managed vector type.

parameters.parameter: Can be one of the following: IPackedVector

overload.returns: true if a match is found; false otherwise.

method.name: TryGetVectorType
method.summary: Searches for a managed vector type that corresponds to a GPU vertex format.

overload.summary: Searches for a managed vector type that corresponds to a GPU vertex format.
overload.returns: true if a match is found; false otherwise.

overload.summary: Searches for a managed vector type that corresponds to a GPU texture format.
overload.returns: true if a match is found; false otherwise.

method.name: TryGetVertexElementFormat
method.summary: Gets the GPU vertex format that corresponds to a managed vector type.

overload.summary: Gets the GPU vertex format that corresponds to a managed vector type.

parameters.parameter: Can be one of the following: IPackedVector

overload.returns: true if a match is found; false otherwise.
